The '''Mandragor Root''' is a trophy dropped by mandragors in Kourna. It is one of a few trophies that can be traded for sweet points all year long.

===Farming===
====[[Arkjok Ward]]====
[[:Image:Mandragor Root Arkjok Ward farming route.jpg|Click here]] to see route in Arkjok Ward.
[[File:Mandragor Root Arkjok Ward farming route.jpg|thumb|right|Farming Luminous Stones in [[Arkjok Ward]]]]

Roughly cover the area following the route provided by the map. A lot of the Mandragor groups are partially or entirely made up of pop-ups. Be careful not to over aggro as you can run into additional pop-ups when manoeuvring or fleeing. At the start of the route you will encounter some groups of [[Insect]]s that you can't evade. Be careful not to fight a group within compass range of another because the [[Veldt Beetle Queen]]s will start healing for other groups, making them potentially difficult to take down.

You will encounter roughly 25 groups of between 3-5 Mandragors if you cover the entire route, netting you approximately 4-5 [[Luminous Stone]]s and 3-4 [[Mandragor Root]]s. One of the groups contains [[Enadiz the Hardheaded]] but he shouldn't prove to be hard with any farm build that is capable of taking on the normal groups.
